sections.title: General Information
paragraphs: The effective date of this filing is upon approval.
The purpose of this filing is to submit a revised Statement of Variability for P 22550-I. The Statement of Variability was
originally approved by your Department on 08/09/2022 under SERFF Tracking Number AMGN-133229794, for issuance to
participants residing in your state under group annuity policies issued by American General Life Insurance Company on a
general use basis for out-of-state scenarios.
We are revising the Statement of Variability to expand the annuity benefit range of options. For ease in your review, we have
attached a redline of the changes to the Supporting Documentation tab.
These changes do not impact any rates filed in your state.
To the best of our knowledge, this filing is complete and intended to comply with the insurance laws of your jurisdiction.
Should you have any questions or require any additional information regarding this submission, please contact me directly.
The contact information under the Companies and Contact tab is correct.

sections.title: Objection Letter
paragraphs: We received your letter submitting the above Revised Statement of Variability for our review. We have reviewed it and wish to
approved by your Department on 08/09/2022 under SERFF Tracking Number AMGN-133229794…on a general use basis for in-state
or out-of-state scenarios”. The filing to which you refer is an out-of-state filing. Please revise the Filing Description and remove the
“in-state” reference, as we are only reviewing the Statement of Variability for use with a Certificate issued on an out-of-state basis.
We suggest that you provide a post-submission update to the General Information tab with the Revised Filing Description. See
COMAR 31.04.17.03C and rule #12 in the Comments section of the “Maryland General Instructions” under the SERFF “Filing Rules”
Thank you for your attention to these matters. We will give this submission our further attention when we receive your
Response. Please include a cover letter with your Response that notes the change made in the Filing Description, and references the
Comment noted in our letter. If you have any questions, or need further clarification, do not hesitate to call or email me. I am usually
Please be advised that failure to respond to this letter within 90 days of the date of this letter will cause the filing to be deemed
withdrawn in accordance with COMAR 31.04.17.05.  If you are interested in pursuing approval of a withdrawn filing, you will be
required to re-file the form(s), supporting documentation and filing fee.  It will then be treated as a new submission.

sections.title: Response Letter
paragraphs: The referenced filing in the Filing Description was approved for use with both in-state and out-state-state scenarios. It
expressly stated that the certificates were being filed for general use and may be used with both in-state and out-of-state group
annuity policies. Accordingly, it does not change the scope of the original approval. Therefore, we respectfully request that the
refence to in-state use remain in the filing description.
